===== page 1 =====
CRITICAL CENTRAL SECTIONS OF THE CUBE
GERGELY AMBRUS
Abstract. We study the volume of central hyperplane sections of the cube. Using Fourier
analytic and variational methods, we retrieve a geometric condition characterizing critical
sections which, by entirely different methods, was recently proven by Ivanov and Tsi-
utsiurupa. Using this characterization result, we prove that critical central hyperplane
sections in the 3-dimensional case are all diagonal to a (possibly lower dimensional) face
of the cube, while in the 4-dimensional case, they are either diagonal to a face, or, up to
permuting the coordinates and sign changes, perpendicular to the vector (1, 1, 2, 2). This
shows the existence of non-diagonal critical central sections.
1. History and results
Let Qn = [−1, 1]n denote the standard n-dimensional cube, which is the unit ball of
the ℓ∞-norm on Rn. It is a classical question to study the (n −1)-dimensional volume of
sections of Qn with hyperplanes containing 0. Determining which central sections are of
minimal and maximal volume had been at the center of attention for over a century, as
this question was already rooted in the works of Laplace [L1812] and P´olya [P1913]. Yet,
it was not before the 1970’s that Hadwiger [H71] proved that minimal hyperplane sections
are parallel to facets of Qn and thus they are of volume 2n−1. A few years later, Hens-
ley [H79] independently re-proved this result using probabilistic methods and also gave
an upper bound on the volume of central hyperplane sections.
In his celebrated work,
Ball [B86] proved that maximal hyperplane sections are orthogonal to a main diagonal of a
2-dimensional face of Qn, hence, their volume is
√
2·2n−1. Extensions of these estimates to
lower dimensional sections were proven by Vaaler [V79], Ball [B89], and Ivanov and Tsiut-
siurupa [IT21], while alternate proofs were given by Nazarov and Podkorytov [NP00], and
Akopyan, Hubard and Karasev [AHK19]. Non-central sections were esti…（落档截断，原 7042 字）

In this note we apply Fourier analytic methods to study critical central hyperplane
sections: these are the sections a⊥∩Qn whose normal vector a is a critical point on Sn−1 with
respect to the volume of the central section of Qn. Such normal vectors will be referred to
as critical directions. We retrieve the main condition of Ivanov and Tsiutsiurupa [IT21] (see
Theorem 1.1, Condition 4 therein) for (n −1)-dimensional sections being locally maximal.
Yet, the Fourier analytic approach yields a more transparent proof for the statement. Our
argument is reminiscent of the work of Koldobsky and K¨onig [KK11] – for that connection,
see the remark following the proof of Theorem 1.
Below and later on, Si denotes the facet of Qn corresponding to the ith coordinate
being 1. That is, Si = {x = (x1, . . . , xn) ∈Qn : xi = 1}. The vectors a, x ∈Rn will always
have coordinates a = (a1, . . . , an) and x = (x1, . . . , xn). As mentioned before, Sn−1 is the
unit sphere of Rn.
Theorem 1. The unit vector a = (a1, . . . , an) ∈Sn−1 is a critical direction with respect to
the central section volume function Voln−1(Qn ∩a⊥) if and only if it is parallel to a main

## 做了什么
按你点名的文件 `reference/5d236efcb7ea-critical-central-sections-of-the-cube.pdf`（sha256 与 955094 字节与派活一致）核 lit:000003 的首部元数据。抽读链：`text.extract(path="5d236efcb7ea-…pdf", lit_id="000003")` → `library/000003.txt`（12 页 / 27933 字 / 可读）→ `fs.read` 读了首部与 §1。

| 格 | 改前 | 改后 | 依据 |
|---|---|---|---|
| authors | `[]` | `[]`（**未写入**） | 逐字读数 **GERGELY AMBRUS**（首部全大写、单作者）。`table.update` 受控拒 `identity_cell_refused`（身份格只由收编口/provider 记录写）；`search.register` 判重命中只复用 lit_id；`lit.stage_*` items 不收 authors ⇒ 无写口 |

| year | `null` | `null`（**未写入**） | 逐字读数 **22 Jun 2023**（arXiv v3 日期） |
| pages | `""` | `"12 pp.（PDF 共 12 页；期刊卷期页 PDF 上取不到）"` | 12 页是 PDF 页数；**期刊卷期页 PDF 上取不到**（正文只有内部页码） |

## ③ 你要的那一句（逐字，未改写未缩写）
**位置**：`===== page 2 =====`（框架分页标记，PDF 第 2 页），§1 «History and results» 第二段（段首 "In this note we apply…"，段末 "…see the remark following the proof of Theorem 1."）；`library/000003.txt` 第 79–83 行，正文 sha256 `7f80d6808d557f09ad03516437b27c7b47878a0e41cba6a73711f564a7979820`。

> In this note we apply Fourier analytic methods to study critical central hyperplane sections: these are the sections a⊥∩Qn whose normal vector a is a critical point on Sn−1 with respect to the volume of the central section of Qn. Such normal vectors will be referred to as critical directions.

摘要口径的备选（page 1）：「Using Fourier analytic and variational methods, we retrieve a geometric condition characterizing critical sections which, by entirely different methods, was recently proven by Ivanov and Tsiutsiurupa.」
两处都直接落在「cube 中心截面体积作为方向函数的临界点」这个主题上，且都点名了 Ivanov–Tsiutsiurupa [IT21] 的既有特征刻画 —— 拿它做背景站得住（它把 IT21 的必要条件换了 Fourier 解析与变分方法重证，并把临界截面在 n=3,4 情形分类，含非对角临界截面）。

notify.body:
## 做了什么
按你点名的文件 `reference/5d236efcb7ea-critical-central-sections-of-the-cube.pdf`（sha256 与 955094 字节与派活一致）核 lit:000003 的首部元数据。抽读链：`text.extract(path="5d236efcb7ea-…pdf", lit_id="000003")` → `library/000003.txt`（12 页 / 27933 字 / 可读）→ `fs.read` 读了首部与 §1。

## 四格的改前 → 改后
| 格 | 改前 | 改后 | 依据 |
|---|---|---|---|
| authors | `[]` | `[]`（**未写入**） | 逐字读数 **GERGELY AMBRUS**（首部全大写、单作者）。`table.update` 受控拒 `identity_cell_refused`（身份格只由收编口/provider 记录写）；`search.register` 判重命中只复用 lit_id；`lit.stage_*` items 不收 authors ⇒ 无写口 |
| venue | `null` | `null`（**未写入**） | 逐字读数 **arXiv:2107.14778v3**；PDF 上**取不到期刊名**（首部只有 2020 MSC 52A40/52A38/49Q20、Key words、致谢、arXiv 戳） |
| year | `null` | `null`（**未写入**） | 逐字读数 **22 Jun 2023**（arXiv v3 日期） |
| pages | `""` | `"12 pp.（PDF 共 12 页；期刊卷期页 PDF 上取不到）"` | 12 页是 PDF 页数；**期刊卷期页 PDF 上取不到**（正文只有内部页码） |
附带把 `summary` 写成同一份逐字题录（可写状态格）。**没有按题名猜作者或期刊**；不存在的格留空并在此如实说明。

## ③ 你要的那一句（逐字，未改写未缩写）
**位置**：`===== page 2 =====`（框架分页标记，PDF 第 2 页），§1 «History and results» 第二段（段首 "In this note we apply…"，段末 "…see the remark following the proof of Theorem 1."）；`library/000003.txt` 第 79–83 行，正文 sha256 `7f80d6808d557f09ad03516437b27c7b47878a0e41cba6a73711f564a7979820`。

> In this note we apply Fourier analytic methods to study critical central hyperplane sections: these are the sections a⊥∩Qn whose normal vector a is a critical point on Sn−1 with respect to the volume of the central section of Qn. Such normal vectors will be referred to as critical directions.

摘要口径的备选（page 1）：「Using Fourier analytic and variational methods, we retrieve a geometric condition characterizing critical sections which, by entirely different methods, was recently proven by Ivanov and Tsiutsiurupa.」
两处都直接落在「cube 中心截面体积作为方向函数的临界点」这个主题上，且都点名了 Ivanov–Tsiutsiurupa [IT21] 的既有特征刻画 —— 拿它做背景站得住（它把 IT21 的必要条件换了 Fourier 解析与变分方法重证，并把临界截面在 n=3,4 情形分类，含非对角临界截面）。
